issue.title: Have a method in Action to check if vehicle is armable

labels.name: beginner
labels.description: A good issue for someone that only gets started

issue.body: Essentially, a method to return the same information as `bool dronecore::Telemetry::health_all_ok() const`

comments.body: I would say this is sort of fixed by #462.
Only if `arming_allowed()` / `takeoff_allowed` are exposed in public API?
That's currently not possible because it depends on the pre-arm checks which are not completely visible from outside PX4 as far as I know.

Is this a reasonable case for a (new) MAVLink message and update to flight stack to emit it? Actually knowing when ready to arm and/or status of preflight checks that are currently hidden would be useful.
@julianoes I'm full of them. Can you drive it? :-)
Ha! Ok I'll put it on my list.

issue.title: Preflight check in simulation??

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
Hello,

I am not sure if the error is related to MAVSDK or to PX4. However, after updating PX4 to the master, I started getting this error during simulation in Gazebo.

```
[02:30:23|Warn ] command temporarily rejected (400). (mavlink_commands.cpp:172)
[02:30:23|Debug] MAVLink: critical: Preflight Fail: Gyro #0 uncalibrated (system_impl.cpp:257)
[02:30:23|Warn ] command temporarily rejected (400). (mavlink_commands.cpp:172)
[02:30:23|Debug] MAVLink: critical: Preflight Fail: Gyro #0 uncalibrated (system_impl.cpp:257)
[02:30:23|Warn ] command temporarily rejected (400). (mavlink_commands.cpp:172)
[02:30:23|Debug] MAVLink: critical: Preflight Fail: Gyro #0 uncalibrated (system_impl.cpp:257)
[02:30:23|Warn ] command temporarily rejected (400). (mavlink_commands.cpp:172)
[02:30:23|Debug] MAVLink: critical: Preflight Fail: Gyro #0 uncalibrated (system_impl.cpp:257)
[02:30:23|Debug] MAVLink: critical: Primary gyro not found (system_impl.cpp:257)
[02:30:23|Debug] MAVLink: critical: Primary gyro not found (system_impl.cpp:257)
[02:30:23|Debug] MAVLink: critical: Primary gyro not found (system_impl.cpp:257)
[02:30:23|Debug] MAVLink: critical: Primary gyro not found (system_impl.cpp:257)
[02:30:23|Debug] MAVLink: critical: system power unavailable (system_impl.cpp:257)
[02:30:23|Debug] MAVLink: critical: system power unavailable (system_impl.cpp:257)
[02:30:23|Debug] MAVLink: critical: system power unavailable (system_impl.cpp:257)
[02:30:23|Debug] MAVLink: critical: system power unavailable (system_impl.cpp:257)

```
Usually, in the simulation, we do not do a calibration. However, I am not sure if the new version of PX4 allows calibration in simulation especially that this is blocking arming and taking off completely. Any thoughts?

Regards,
